title: AB87 (2017 Regular): Revises provisions relating to permits to carry concealed firearms issued by certain other states. (BDR 15-96)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Nevada) (gun-policy Stage 5, Nevada); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Nevada text (As introduced, official copy, https://archive.leg.state.nv.us/Session/79th2017/Bills/AB/AB87.pdf; sha256 002892daf3cb729ed498380c4f9bb1f457ced8b9221ffb0a059c3cbf4085dc1b)
provenance.note: As-filed version (prefiled January 27, 2017); no passage vote on record. The bill strikes existing subsection 2, which barred a new resident from carrying on the other state's permit after 60 days without a Nevada permit; the quoted sentence is the remaining text, whose opening words are partly marked as changed.

operative_text: Section 1 (NRS 202.3688): A person who possesses a permit to carry a concealed firearm that was issued by a state included in the list prepared pursuant to NRS 202.3689 may carry a concealed firearm in this State in accordance with the requirements set forth in NRS 202.3653 to 202.369, inclusive.
